# make_framework_trace { #mofography.movies.make_framework_trace }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Full mesh framework; heavier than instanced or scatter traces. Use `make_framework_instanced_trace` instead.

```python
movies.make_framework_trace(
    atoms,
    bonds='auto',
    style='framework',
    name='Framework',
    trace_id='framework',
    representation='ball_and_stick',
)
```

Build a Three.js mesh trace for framework atoms and covalent bonds.
